svg.aria-label: Lead story: Full-Stack Engineer Ships the Boring, Load‑Bearing Parts — On Purpose. Remote-first, filing from Kolkata — Anirban Das is a full-stack developer who builds the boring-but-critical parts well: auth, data, real-time, and the AI features layered on top. He started chasing clean UIs; now he chases correctness under load.

svg.text: Four years and four teams: document intelligence at Bau.ai in
Berlin, AI-assisted diagnostics at Medecro.ai, an in-browser OS
frontend at ProjectX, and legal-tech at Legabyte. The
through-line never changes: own the data model, the API, and
the frontend — then stay through the on-call.
